detail.longDescription: The Planetary Society: New Planetary Society study finds that NASA’s cheapest science missions can’t replace larger ones. “[The Planetary Society’s new Science Mission Impact dashboard] tracks 143 NASA-led science missions launched from 1980 through 2024, across all five science divisions, along with their inflation-adjusted costs and 148,667 peer-reviewed papers associated with them.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/11/13/the-planetary-society-new-planetary-society-study-finds-that-nasas-cheapest-science-missions-cant-replace-larger-ones/
